protocol.label: vaapi-direct-map-4k
protocol.scenario: 4K native-size X11 CPU viewer VA-API direct map

method: One pinned Ubuntu fixed H.264 NVENC host using exact MIT-SHM readback; one pinned Mint caller-supplied binary using VA-API and CPU X11 RGB presentation with the flag unset or set to 1. Software stage summaries use whole telemetry windows and their per-window quantiles. Per-window fallback counts include frames after a decoder scope stopped retrying. Only visible, increasing source markers in the exact local 60-second interval count toward 27 FPS. Raw logs retain typed records and sanitized failure/route diagnostics.

viewer_build.scope: Verified candidate build and retained Cargo test records. The release binary hash is verified against the viewer pin. The test counts describe separate Cargo test executables from the retained build lane.
